title: Searched intrinsic rewards transfer in one toy task but fail under a shortcut
summary: In a preregistered reinforcement-learning study, search-selected intrinsic rewards transferred to a held-out task in one toy environment, but the learned agent failed a separate reset-action tampering test. The result demonstrates task-specific transfer and a tested failure mode; it does not establish general resistance to exploitation.
ai_technology: CMA-ES and random search for reward weights; PPO agents for task evaluation

evidence.tested: Fresh-seed held-out comparisons assessed reward transfer; a separate reset-action intervention exposed a failure under tampering.
evidence.unknown: The transfer result is from one toy environment and does not establish general exploit resistance.
evidence.ai_role: Search methods tune intrinsic-reward weights; PPO evaluates task learning, transfer and response to the reset-action intervention.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
